from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-ws0/frozen/seen/play/users/u057/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):\n    out = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])\n    for r in range(h):\n        cols = [c for c, value in enumerate(grid[r]) if value == 7]\n        if len(cols) >= 2:\n            for c in range(min(cols), max(cols) + 1):\n                if grid[r][c] != 7:\n                    out[r][c] = 3\n    for c in range(w):\n        rows = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r][c] == 7]\n        if len(rows) >= 2:\n            for r in range(min(rows), max(rows) + 1):\n                if grid[r][c] != 7:\n                    out[r][c] = 3\n    return out\n'''
path=programs/'task-f2d7bb4b.py'
path.write_text(source)
# demo pair
inp=[[9,9,9,9,9,9,9,9,9,9,9],[9,9,9,9,1,9,9,9,9,1,9],[9,9,9,9,9,9,9,9,9,9,9],[9,9,9,9,9,9,9,9,1,9,9],[9,9,9,9,9,9,9,9,9,9,9],[1,9,9,9,9,9,9,9,9,1,9],[9,9,9,9,9,9,9,9,9,9,9],[9,9,9,1,1,9,9,9,9,9,9],[9,9,9,9,9,9,9,1,9,9,9],[1,9,9,9,9,9,1,1,9,9,9]]
# adapt symbolic colors of 1=>7, 9=>1 per task, then transform; output remap test colors: background 1, points 7, drawn 3.
adapt=[[7 if x==1 else 1 for x in row] for row in inp]
from importlib.util import spec_from_file_location, module_from_spec
spec=spec_from_file_location('taskprog',path); mod=module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
res=mod.transform(adapt)
expected=[[7 if x==1 else 3 if x==3 else 1 for x in row] for row in [[9,9,9,9,9,9,9,9,9,9,9],[9,9,9,9,1,3,3,3,3,1,9],[9,9,9,9,3,9,9,9,9,3,9],[9,9,9,9,3,9,9,9,1,3,9],[9,9,9,9,3,9,9,9,9,3,9],[1,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,1,9],[3,9,9,9,3,9,9,9,9,9,9],[3,9,9,1,1,9,9,9,9,9,9],[3,9,9,9,9,9,9,1,9,9,9],[1,3,3,3,3,3,1,1,9,9,9]]]
print('rows', len(res), 'expected match?', res==expected)
if res!=expected:
 for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(res,expected)):
  if a!=b: print(i,a,b)
